en: Isaiah 59

p.src: 1  Behold, the LORD’s hand is not shortened, that it can’t save; nor his ear dull, that it can’t hear.

ja: えないほど短くなく、 その
こえないほど鈍くない。
en: Behold, the LORD’s hand is not shortened, that it can’t save; nor his ear dull, that it can’t hear.
u.src: 1  Behold, the LORD’s hand is not shortened, that it can’t save; nor his ear dull, that it can’t hear.

p.src: 2  But your iniquities have separated you and your God, and your sins have hidden his face from you, so that he will not hear.

ja: しかし、あなたがたの咎が、あなたがたと、あなたがたの
したので、 主は聞こうとされない。
en: But your iniquities have separated you and your God, and your sins have hidden his face from you, so that he will not hear.
u.src: 2  But your iniquities have separated you and your God, and your sins have hidden his face from you, so that he will not hear.

p.src: 3  For your hands are defiled with blood, and your fingers with iniquity. Your lips have spoken lies. Your tongue mutters wickedness.

ja: れている。 あなたがたの
en: For your hands are defiled with blood, and your fingers with iniquity. Your lips have spoken lies. Your tongue mutters wickedness.
u.src: 3  For your hands are defiled with blood, and your fingers with iniquity. Your lips have spoken lies. Your tongue mutters wickedness.

p.src: 4  No one sues in righteousness, and no one pleads in truth. They trust in vanity and speak lies. They conceive mischief and give birth to iniquity.

ja: らはむなしいものに信
る。 災いを身ごもり、 咎を産む。
en: No one sues in righteousness, and no one pleads in truth. They trust in vanity and speak lies. They conceive mischief and give birth to iniquity.
u.src: 4  No one sues in righteousness, and no one pleads in truth. They trust in vanity and speak lies. They conceive mischief and give birth to iniquity.

p.src: 5  They hatch adders’ eggs and weave the spider’s web. He who eats of their eggs dies; and that which is crushed breaks out into a viper.

ja: がつぶされると、まむしが
en: They hatch adders’ eggs and weave the spider’s web. He who eats of their eggs dies; and that which is crushed breaks out into a viper.
u.src: 5  They hatch adders’ eggs and weave the spider’s web. He who eats of their eggs dies; and that which is crushed breaks out into a viper.

p.src: 6  Their webs won’t become garments. They won’t cover themselves with their works. Their works are works of iniquity, and acts of violence are in their hands.

ja: その巣が衣になることはなく、
en: Their webs won’t become garments. They won’t cover themselves with their works. Their works are works of iniquity, and acts of violence are in their hands.
u.src: 6  Their webs won’t become garments. They won’t cover themselves with their works. Their works are works of iniquity, and acts of violence are in their hands.

p.src: 7  Their feet run to evil, and they hurry to shed innocent blood. Their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity. Desolation and destruction are in their paths.

ja: い。 荒廃と滅びがその
en: Their feet run to evil, and they hurry to shed innocent blood. Their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity. Desolation and destruction are in their paths.
u.src: 7  Their feet run to evil, and they hurry to shed innocent blood. Their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity. Desolation and destruction are in their paths.

p.src: 8  They don’t know the way of peace; and there is no justice in their ways. They have made crooked paths for themselves; whoever goes in them doesn’t know peace.

ja: らず、 その道筋には
を造った。 そこを歩む
en: They don’t know the way of peace; and there is no justice in their ways. They have made crooked paths for themselves; whoever goes in them doesn’t know peace.
u.src: 8  They don’t know the way of peace; and there is no justice in their ways. They have made crooked paths for themselves; whoever goes in them doesn’t know peace.

p.src: 9  Therefore justice is far from us, and righteousness doesn’t overtake us. We look for light, but see darkness; for brightness, but we walk in obscurity.

ja: いつかない。 われわれは
en: Therefore justice is far from us, and righteousness doesn’t overtake us. We look for light, but see darkness; for brightness, but we walk in obscurity.
u.src: 9  Therefore justice is far from us, and righteousness doesn’t overtake us. We look for light, but see darkness; for brightness, but we walk in obscurity.

p.src: 10  We grope for the wall like the blind. Yes, we grope as those who have no eyes. We stumble at noon as if it were twilight. Among those who are strong, we are like dead men.

ja: われわれは目の見えない者のように
でも夕暮れのようにつまずき、
者のようになっている。
en: We grope for the wall like the blind. Yes, we grope as those who have no eyes. We stumble at noon as if it were twilight. Among those who are strong, we are like dead men.
u.src: 10  We grope for the wall like the blind. Yes, we grope as those who have no eyes. We stumble at noon as if it were twilight. Among those who are strong, we are like dead men.

p.src: 11  We all roar like bears and moan sadly like doves. We look for justice, but there is none, for salvation, but it is far off from us.

ja: のように悲しげにうめく。
en: We all roar like bears and moan sadly like doves. We look for justice, but there is none, for salvation, but it is far off from us.
u.src: 11  We all roar like bears and moan sadly like doves. We look for justice, but there is none, for salvation, but it is far off from us.

p.src: 12  For our transgressions are multiplied before you, and our sins testify against us; for our transgressions are with us, and as for our iniquities, we know them:

ja: をする。 われわれの
きはわれわれとともにあり、 われわれは
en: For our transgressions are multiplied before you, and our sins testify against us; for our transgressions are with us, and as for our iniquities, we know them:
u.src: 12  For our transgressions are multiplied before you, and our sins testify against us; for our transgressions are with us, and as for our iniquities, we know them:

p.src: 13  transgressing and denying the LORD, and turning away from following our God, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering from the heart words of falsehood.

ja: き、主を否み、 われわれの
en: transgressing and denying the LORD, and turning away from following our God, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering from the heart words of falsehood.
u.src: 13  transgressing and denying the LORD, and turning away from following our God, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering from the heart words of falsehood.

p.src: 14  Justice is turned away backward, and righteousness stands far away; for truth has fallen in the street, and uprightness can’t enter.

en: Justice is turned away backward, and righteousness stands far away; for truth has fallen in the street, and uprightness can’t enter.
u.src: 14  Justice is turned away backward, and righteousness stands far away; for truth has fallen in the street, and uprightness can’t enter.

p.src: 15  Yes, truth is lacking; and he who departs from evil makes himself a prey. The LORD saw it, and it displeased him that there was no justice.

ja: 正がないことを良いとされなかった。
en: Yes, truth is lacking; and he who departs from evil makes himself a prey. The LORD saw it, and it displeased him that there was no justice.
u.src: 15  Yes, truth is lacking; and he who departs from evil makes himself a prey. The LORD saw it, and it displeased him that there was no justice.

zh: 耶和華準備拯救他的子民

p.src: 16  He saw that there was no man, and wondered that there was no intercessor. Therefore his own arm brought salvation to him; and his righteousness sustained him.

ja: かれた。 それゆえ、ご
en: He saw that there was no man, and wondered that there was no intercessor. Therefore his own arm brought salvation to him; and his righteousness sustained him.
u.src: 16  He saw that there was no man, and wondered that there was no intercessor. Therefore his own arm brought salvation to him; and his righteousness sustained him.

p.src: 17  He put on righteousness as a breastplate, and a helmet of salvation on his head. He put on garments of vengeance for clothing, and was clad with zeal as a mantle.

en: He put on righteousness as a breastplate, and a helmet of salvation on his head. He put on garments of vengeance for clothing, and was clad with zeal as a mantle.
u.src: 17  He put on righteousness as a breastplate, and a helmet of salvation on his head. He put on garments of vengeance for clothing, and was clad with zeal as a mantle.

p.src: 18  According to their deeds, he will repay as appropriate: wrath to his adversaries, recompense to his enemies. He will repay the islands their due.

ja: じて、 主はふさわしく
々にもその受けるべきものを
en: According to their deeds, he will repay as appropriate: wrath to his adversaries, recompense to his enemies. He will repay the islands their due.
u.src: 18  According to their deeds, he will repay as appropriate: wrath to his adversaries, recompense to his enemies. He will repay the islands their due.

p.src: 19  So they will fear the LORD’s name from the west, and his glory from the rising of the sun; for he will come as a rushing stream, which the LORD’s breath drives.

ja: せる川のように来られ、
の息がそれを駆り立てるからだ。
en: So they will fear the LORD’s name from the west, and his glory from the rising of the sun; for he will come as a rushing stream, which the LORD’s breath drives.
u.src: 19  So they will fear the LORD’s name from the west, and his glory from the rising of the sun; for he will come as a rushing stream, which the LORD’s breath drives.

p.src: 20  “A Redeemer will come to Zion, and to those who turn from disobedience in Jacob,” says the LORD.

en: “A Redeemer will come to Zion, and to those who turn from disobedience in Jacob,” says the LORD.
u.src: 20  “A Redeemer will come to Zion, and to those who turn from disobedience in Jacob,” says the LORD.

p.src: 21  “As for me, this is my covenant with them,” says the LORD. “My Spirit who is on you, and my words which I have put in your mouth shall not depart out of your mouth, nor out of the mouth of your offspring, nor out of the mouth of your offspring’s offspring,” says the LORD, “from now on and forever.”

ja: われる。「わたしは、これを
en: “As for me, this is my covenant with them,” says the LORD. “My Spirit who is on you, and my words which I have put in your mouth shall not depart out of your mouth, nor out of the mouth of your offspring, nor out of the mouth of your offspring’s offspring,” says the LORD, “from now on and forever.”
u.src: 21  “As for me, this is my covenant with them,” says the LORD. “My Spirit who is on you, and my words which I have put in your mouth shall not depart out of your mouth, nor out of the mouth of your offspring, nor out of the mouth of your offspring’s offspring,” says the LORD, “from now on and forever.”
